description: Replaces Int128 widening in PriorityKey.ToTimestampTicks with a truncated whole-second range pre-check (window.Ticks / TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond > long.MaxValue / frequency) followed by unchecked 64-bit multiplication (unchecked(window.Ticks * frequency) / TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond). Whole-second windows above long.MaxValue / frequency still throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException (though fractional-second remainders such as window.Ticks = 10_000_001 at frequency = long.MaxValue slip past the integer-division pre-check without throwing), and sub-minute windows at <= 1 GHz pass unchanged, while valid windows where window.Ticks * timestampFrequency exceeds long.MaxValue (for example >= 923 seconds on a 1 GHz monotonic clock) wrap signed 64-bit multiplication and reverse boost polarity.
violatedClause: Converting each configured TimeSpan window to timestamp-frequency units truncates fractional units toward zero once using exact integer arithmetic, without floating-point rounding or intermediate 64-bit multiplication overflow when window.Ticks * timestampFrequency exceeds long.MaxValue.
